champion.tips: AZIR TIPS AND TRICKS Stand at the maximum distance possible when playing against melee champions so they cannot get on to you. Use your range advantage against these champions to keep them low. Use your Ultimate R as a defensive tool rather than a tool to engage with if it’s not necessary. Don’t worry, you don’t have to be the playmaker all the time. You can build a replacement tower in the middle lane after taking the tower and then look to roam.
champion.builds: THE BEST AZIR BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Azir Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Overgrowth in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Nashor's Tooth as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Rylai's Crystal Scepter. For your last 3 items, you should build Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and finish with Void Staff. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 43.6% winrate over 289 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Gathering Storm with Manaflow Band in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Liandry's Torment as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Nashor's Tooth as a third item. You want to finish the build with Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 45.9% win rate across 74 matches played. Situational Azir Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Azir build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Azir runes page.
